setting.culture: A Muslim family in Muscat; whitewashed houses, the corniche, fishing boats, kites on the beach.

data.title: Up Now!

premise.hero_want: Hamza wants his toy kite to fly high above the beach.
premise.problem: The kite stays low because its cord hangs slack.
premise.mechanism: Hamza notices the slack cord and decides to tug it. Mum tugs the same cord with him.
premise.resolution: The kite rises high, then drifts gently down as Hamza grins at Mum.

key_objects.name: Toy kite
key_objects.description: A simple red diamond-shaped kite with a yellow centre. It has no tail.

key_objects.name: Kite cord
key_objects.description: One plain white cord fixed to the kite, with no reel.

cast.who: Hamza, a six-year-old Muslim boy in Muscat
cast.appearance: Medium-brown skin, short black curls, a teal long-sleeved top, tan full-length trousers and sandals. His eyes are solid black filled ovals.
Medium-brown skin, a rose-pink hijab, a navy abaya covering her shoulders and knees, and flat shoes. Her eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: I am Hamza. I am on the sand with Mum.
pages.scene: Hamza and Mum stand together on a quiet Muscat beach. Hamza holds the white cord of the red kite. The corniche, whitewashed houses and two fishing boats sit in the background. Their modest clothes cover shoulders and knees. All eyes are solid black filled ovals. No other people.

pages.text: My toy is low. It will not go up.
pages.scene: The same kite hangs just above the sand, still fixed to the same cord in Hamza's hand. Hamza looks up while Mum stays beside him. Keep the same beach, houses and fishing boats. All eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: The cord hangs down. I will tug it with Mum.
pages.scene: Hamza notices the same white cord hanging slack. He points to it and looks at Mum as he decides what to do. Mum listens beside him. Their clothes remain modest, and all eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Mum and I tug the cord. Up, up, up!
pages.scene: Hamza leads as he and Mum safely tug the same cord together. The red kite starts to rise. They remain in one spot on the beach. All eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: My toy is high now. It dips, then it is up.
pages.scene: The same red kite flies high above Hamza and Mum, with its white cord pulled straight. Hamza watches it dip and rise while Mum stays beside him. The corniche and whitewashed houses remain behind them. All eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: My toy drifts down. I grin at Mum.
pages.scene: The kite drifts gently towards Hamza and Mum on the same patch of sand. Hamza grins at Mum, and she smiles back. Fishing boats rest on the calm water behind them. Their shoulders and knees are covered. All eyes are solid black filled ovals. No other people.
